items.title: AWS achieves Spain’s national Limited Distribution (Difusión Limitada) and NATO Restricted accreditation in the AWS Europe (Spain) Region
items.summary: Spanish version » Amazon Web Services (AWS) is pleased to announce that AWS has achieved Spain’s national Limited Distribution (“Difusión Limitada”) and NATO Restricted accreditation for the AWS Europe (Spain) Region. The Difusión Limitada and NATO Restricted accreditation was granted by the Spanish Delegated Authority for the Security of Classified Information, the Secretary of State […]
